smoothing.derivatives: first and second derivatives of the fitted cubic
smoothing.gaps: a missing observation ends a run; runs are never bridged and edges are never extrapolated

anchors.source: lowest and highest five-minute close across the observed sessions of the parent window

colour.note: fixed constants; a renderer never chooses these per session

method.tieRule: an exact midpoint selects the higher landmark
method.flatRule: a flat parent window (high == low) gives the tonic everywhere and a stationary orbit

orbit.y: acceleration, price units per minute squared
orbit.path: chronological polyline within each run; the last point is not joined to the first

parent.definition: the trailing five trading sessions ending with this session, each sampled as five-minute closes
parent.observationMinutes: the close of each five-minute block: session minutes 4, 9, ..., 389

smoothing.gaps: each session is its own run; overnight is never bridged
